title: Step 1a - Data Preprocessing for MLR: Handling Categorical Data

cues.en: Instructor: Hello, and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: In the following tutorials we will be implementing multiple linear regression in R.
cues.zh: 接下來幾堂課，要在 R 裡實作多元線性迴歸。

cues.en: And right now, as usual, we are going to start with the basics which is to set our folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，先設定資料夾為工作目錄。

cues.en: So right now I'm on my desktop.
cues.zh: 目前我在桌面。

cues.en: I'm going to my machine learning A-Z folder, then part 2 regression.
cues.zh: 進入 Machine Learning A-Z、Part 2 Regression。

cues.en: And then we want to go to multiple linear regression.
cues.zh: 再進 Multiple Linear Regression。

cues.en: And here is the folder.
cues.zh: 就是這個資料夾。

cues.en: Make sure that you have the 50_startups.CSV file.
cues.zh: 確認裡面有 50_Startups.csv。

cues.en: And if that's the case, you're ready to click on this more button here to set the folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 如果有，就點 More，把它設為工作目錄。

cues.en: All right, now let's start with step one, which is to prepare the data to make our multiple linear regression ready to be built.
cues.zh: 開始第一步，準備資料，讓多元線性迴歸可以建立。

cues.en: So, as usual, we're gonna use our template the data pre-processing template that we made in part 1 and we are just going to copy this, copy and paste it here.
cues.zh: 一樣使用第一部分的資料前處理模板，複製後貼到這裡。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now let's take care of the few things to change.
cues.zh: 修改必要的幾個地方。

cues.en: So first we will change the name of the dataset, which is here, 50 startups.
cues.zh: 首先改資料集名稱，這裡是 50_Startups。

cues.en: All right, 50_startups.csv.
cues.zh: 也就是 50_Startups.csv。

cues.en: We can select this and execute to have a look at our dataset.
cues.zh: 選取並執行，看看資料集。

cues.en: Here it is.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: And that's the data set.
cues.zh: 這就是資料。

cues.en: I'll remind what this data set is about.
cues.zh: 再回顧一下內容。

cues.en: So this contains informations of startups, actually 50 startups, and these informations are some amount of money spent.
cues.zh: 它包含 50 家新創的資訊，包括不同支出金額。

cues.en: So, for example, there is the amount spent in R&D, administration, marketing.
cues.zh: 例如研發、行政、行銷費用。

cues.en: And finally, there is also the state in which the startup operates.
cues.zh: 另外還有新創營運所在的州。

cues.en: And finally, we have a last column here which is the profit.
cues.zh: 最後一欄是 Profit。

cues.en: And that's the profit we want to predict with our multiple linear regression models.
cues.zh: 這就是要用多元線性迴歸預測的利潤。

cues.en: And we want to predict that profit based on this independent variables, which are the R&D spend, the administration, marketing spend, and the state.
cues.zh: 根據研發、行政、行銷支出與州別這些自變數，預測利潤。

cues.en: So we are doing this because we are doing a mission for investors who want to know in which startup they should invest their money.
cues.zh: 因為我們在替投資人做分析，他們想知道該把錢投資在哪類新創。

cues.en: And so not only they want to predict the future profits for new startups based on the same informations, but also they want to see which independent variable has the highest effect on the profit
cues.zh: 不只要根據相同資訊預測新公司的未來利潤，也想知道，哪個自變數對利潤影響最大，

cues.en: and which one governs the relationship between the profit and those independent variables.
cues.zh: 哪個主導這些自變數與利潤的關係。

cues.en: Is there an independent variable that has a highest effect than another one?
cues.zh: 是否某個變數比其他變數有更大影響？

cues.en: Does the states in which the startup operates have an impact on the profit?
cues.zh: 公司所在州會影響利潤嗎？

cues.en: We'll find that out thanks to our multiple linear regression model in R.
cues.zh: 透過 R 的多元線性迴歸，就能探索。

cues.en: And thanks to this model the investors will be able to draw some insights from our results.
cues.zh: 投資人也能從結果獲得洞見。

cues.en: Okay, so now the next sub-step of the first step, data pre-processing, is to split the data set into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 接著，資料前處理下一個子步驟，是切分訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: But is it the sub-step we need to do right now?
cues.zh: 但現在真的該做這一步嗎？

cues.en: I know that the template is suggesting that but let's not forget that in our dataset we have one specific variable which should strike our attention.
cues.zh: 雖然模板這樣排，但別忘了資料集有一個需要特別留意的變數。

cues.en: Well, it's this one, it's the state variable because it contains categories which means it's a categorical variable.
cues.zh: 就是 State，因為內容是類別，所以是類別變數。

cues.en: And remember, when we have a categorical variable like this, with categories written in text, this would cause some issues in our machine learning model equations
cues.zh: 記得，當類別用文字表示時，在模型方程式中會遇到問題，

cues.en: because how do you wanna make a linear equation with one of the variable written as text?
cues.zh: 因為怎麼能把文字變數直接放進線性方程式？

cues.en: Wouldn't make any sense.
cues.zh: 那不合理。

cues.en: So what we're gonna do, of course, is to encode the state variable.
cues.zh: 所以當然要編碼 State。

cues.en: And to do this we are gonna use what we learned in part 1 data pre-processing, only we didn't include that in a template because this will actually be one of the only examples where we'll need
cues.zh: 使用第一部分資料前處理所學，只是模板沒放這段，因為課程裡需要

cues.en: to encode our categorical data.
cues.zh: 類別編碼的例子不多。

cues.en: We put it in a separate file.
cues.zh: 我們把它放在另一個檔案。

cues.en: And so right now we are going to open the separate file.
cues.zh: 所以現在打開那份獨立工具檔。
